answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The violet of work and the karst of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a raven to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
